text:
Sam Carter: Hey team — BankCorp POC kickoff. They are fully air-gapped. Need quick answers: how do we deliver installer for their VMs (USB / scp / offline repo), what's our recommended upgrade cadence for a POC (delta vs full bundle), and ballpark offline POC pricing? Also they asked about offline rollback story.
Anya Patel: We can provide a signed immutable bundle + delta patch tarballs. Delivery options: exported S3 tar (signed), physical USB, or an encrypted transfer via courier. For a POC I usually recommend 1 full bundle + up to 3 delta patches so they can validate updates without re-seeding the whole image.
Rafael Gomez: Upgrade cadence guidance: production customers typically run monthly security deltas and quarterly feature bundles. For a short POC we can compress cadence to 2-week deltas but that increases ops risk. Rollback story: bundle-id pinning + migration-safe flags; we keep artifacts immutable and the operator can roll back by redeploying previous bundle id.
Rafael Gomez: Quick verification examples (send to customer):
```
# verify signature
gpg --verify redwood-bundle.tar.gz.sig redwood-bundle.tar.gz
# verify checksum
sha256sum -c redwood-bundle.sha256
```
Anya Patel: Recommend the activation manifest pattern: manifest includes bundle sha256, signing-key fingerprint, bundle-id, and a small install manifest that the on-prem operator applies in staging before promoting to prod. That reduces blast radius.
Sam Carter: Pricing question from BankCorp: offline POC license + 2x eng days of support (remote) + media handling. Ballpark?
Nora (Legal): Need an EULA addendum for physical media custody and export controls. Also flag: model weights may be subject to export restrictions depending on region — include a short clause about customer responsibility for custody of weights.
Rafael Gomez: SRE/Eng line items: 2 SE days for onboarding (artifact build + runbook), 3 SRE days for bundle validation, test host, and rollback playbook. If physical media required, add courier & handling costs. For a condensed POC I would estimate $20–30k fixed for the package (includes signatures, manifests, 1 on-site day if required).
Sam Carter: They also asked about key management: can customer supply KMS/HSM for signing so they keep private keys on-prem?
Anya Patel: Yes — for Private we support customer-managed keys. For POCs we usually use Redwood signing but we can create an HSM-backed flow: customer generates a keypair in their HSM, exports a public cert, we sign the manifest with Redwood's attestation key + customer's public key listed in the manifest. If they insist on end-to-end customer key control we need engineering time to wire in the signing API.
ops-bot: checklist created: POC-offline-ship -> [build bundle], [create manifest + sha256], [sign bundle], [produce delta tar], [test install], [rollback playbook] :white_check_mark:
Sam Carter: Next steps — schedule a 45m call with BankCorp infra + security, share sample manifest and a draft SOW. @Anya can you lead artifact build? @Rafael pls draft rollback playbook. I'll put call on calendar for Wed 10am.
Anya Patel: On it. I'll prep a sample bundle and a delta patch example. Will attach sample manifest and signature before EOD Tue.
Rafael Gomez: I'll draft rollback playbook with DB migration guard checklist and a safe-promote procedure (staging -> canary -> prod).
Sam Carter: Great — thanks everyone. I'll include Nora on the SOW draft for the custody clause. :thumbsup:
